channel.title: Code-Review on Junho Lee
channel.description: Recent content in Code-Review on Junho Lee

item.title: Handing Post-PR Work to Claude Code: /ship, /steward, and Approval Policies
item.description: How to hand CI failures, review comments, and merge conflicts to /code-review, /ship, and /steward, where to write down repeated review feedback, and how to trial a team approval policy in observe mode before enforcing it.

item.title: You Own What You Ship: Reading the No AI Slop Manifesto
item.description: A plain-language walkthrough of the No AI Slop manifesto written by AIE Code Summit 2026 speakers and attendees: its definition of slop, the asymmetry behind it, five values, and twelve resolutions, with practical examples and a check against this blog’s own curation pipeline.

item.title: Reviewing Agent-Generated Code at Scale: Six Verification Layers on the Claude Code Team
item.description: How the Claude Code team—where Claude writes roughly 90% of the code—replaced line-by-line human gatekeeping with six automated verification layers, risk-based approval counts, convergence rules for agent review loops, and fast rollback.

item.title: What an AI-Native Team Leaves in Its Repo: Inside DeepSeek Harness
item.description: An analysis of the DeepSeek Harness repository covering AGENTS.md completion rules, status-based Agent Notes folders, and shared team skills.

item.title: 5 Practical Claude Code Plugins for Daily Development
item.description: Review five Claude Code plugins covering pre-coding design, UI implementation, multi-agent PR review, security auditing, and SQLite-backed session memory.
